description:
Company Payroll Setup

Short steps, prefilled with what the company already has: canton, UID and the person in charge of the payroll; the rates of the AVS fund, LAA, IJM, LAAC and family allowance policies; the salary rules of the contracts (13th, 14th and 15th salaries and their provision, the value of a vacation day paid at the exit, the flat-rate expenses); the canton's public holidays; how salaries and social charges are booked, on which accounts, and whether the salaries leave the bank as one debit; the salary certificate header. It creates the company's default social insurance configuration. Run it again any time to change a choice.
name: Configure the Company Payroll
title: Set up the company's payroll: insurances, salary rules, holidays, accounting
